title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: One tap. On 8 November you made Epic's resizable outfits the clothing backbone, to be decided by today's test. What was found: Epic's resizing is already in the game (the white base layer is Epic's own outfit fitted to each person), but it bakes an ordinary fixed garment per person, about the size of ours on disk (its cost while playing not measured). The real test with Tom's jumper was not run: no full script route was found. Cheaper first tries exist and were not tried (copying Epic's outfit by script; Epic's free Techwear outfit); a small piece of editor code, roughly 4 hours, is the surest. Corrected 12:35 against its reviewer. Pick one.
sections.recommendation: Keep our own garments, carried from body to body (Sheila's blouse and skirt carried in about half an hour each; fit faults still open), and test Epic's resizing in phase 5 for the crowd, cheapest route first.
options: Keep our garments; Epic's resizing later for the crowd (recommended)
Spend about 4 hours this week on the real test with Tom's jumper

sections.name: One tap. Start the next work session every 15 minutes instead of every hour. Today about 1 h 45 min was lost to gaps after a session stopped just past the hourly start. A start is skipped while a session is still working, so it costs nothing then. On yes: the schedule changes, a session hands over as soon as it is full, and the guard against two sessions at once stays.
sections.recommendation: Yes: it closes the gaps between sessions at no extra cost.

sections.name: One tap to make your words of 11:51 a standing ruling: efficiency is the project's first philosophy, never at the cost of quality; checks and improvements come on their own, daily, or as decisions for you. On yes it goes into the rulings, replacing the 5 and 7 November efficiency line, and a daily waste report runs by 19:00.
sections.recommendation: Yes: it is what you said, and it puts the daily check on record.
